text:
anya: quick heads-up — ran the mobile sampleapp in DEBUG and saw unredacted emails in device logs. noticed during onboarding flow.
jamal: can you paste an example line?
anya: `2025-02-14T15:02:01.123Z DEBUG req=evt42 user_email=pat.smith@example.com event="signup:complete"`
maria: is this the node-mobile bundle? we've got different OTEL hook ordering between node-mobile and native bridge.
anya: yes, node-mobile (index.native.js entry).
ryan: scrubber should remove `user_email` before any logger emits. sounds like the redact middleware ran after logger init here — ordering bug.
sec-jen: tagging security. were these logs shipped to OTLP/sentry or just local simulator stdout?
anya: just local and CI integration job reproduces it. ci-bot: build 3120 failed: integration/mobile-debug — assertion `no-email-in-output` failed (see https://ci.redwood/3120).
jamal: minimal repro created. quick fixes: (1) move redact middleware earlier in init, (2) add console shim to sanitize direct `console.*` calls, or (3) make scrub idempotent and wire it into the logger transport.
ryan: also add parity tests vs Go/android: ensure their init path doesn't allow this. unit test: assert no `@` or `.com` in debug logs captured. e2e: run signup flow and grep logs.
maria: i'll open a PR: reorder OTEL/log init in index.native.js, add `REDACT_DEBUG_LOGS` env var (default true in CI), and include integration test `integration/mobile-debug/no-pii-in-debug`.
anya: can we gate with feature flag so internal dev clusters can opt-out? want a console warning if disabled in prod.
sec-jen: require `REDACT_DEBUG_LOGS=true` for prod hotfix. file incident and notify support if any customer repros.
jamal: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/mobile-sdk/pull/1048 — includes console shim + reordered init + tests. requesting review from @maria @ryan.
ryan: quick pass done, left comment about flake on simulator timing. overall LGTM. :thumbsup:
maria: merged to canary, kicking canary deploy to dev. monitoring for scrub assertion failures and OTLP spans.
ci-bot: regression test `integration/mobile-debug/no-pii-in-debug` added and passing locally.
anya: thanks. follow-up: update onboarding docs: "initialize telemetry & redact hooks before any debug helpers or sample flows" so new devs don't accidentally leak PII during local testing. :memo:
